items.q: Do you serve Pefferlaw and rural Georgina properties?

items.q: Can you clean out a workshop as well as a warehouse?
a: Yes. A workshop or additional storage area can be included when it forms part of the agreed commercial cleanout.

items.q: Can you remove tenant-left items from a commercial property?
a: Yes. Accepted tenant-left contents such as pallets, shelving, furniture, inventory, electronics and general commercial junk can be cleared as part of a landlord or property-manager cleanout.
